children: Las Vegas Sands Corp. said Sands China priced $700M 6.400% notes due 2032 and $300M 6.700% notes due 2033, with closing expected Nov. 3, 2026. Proceeds of about $989M and cash will redeem $700M 2.300% 2027 notes, repay its 2024 revolver, and fund general purposes.
Sets cost and size of new debt, impacting interest expense and liquidity.
Refinancing at higher coupon lifts future interest costs.
Indicates fees/discounts; cash inflow size guides leverage math.
Removes near-term maturity but replaces with higher-rate debt.
Cuts floating-rate exposure and frees credit capacity.

This is a mid-cycle balance-sheet refinance, swapping a low-coupon 2027 bond and revolver borrowings for longer-dated fixed notes. A larger catalyst would be clarity on interest expense run-rate post-refi and any rating or listing outcomes once the notes are admitted in Hong Kong.
